protocol.sparse: 50 warm-up + 300 contiguous samples, fixed 1/60 step, native Canvas pixel readback
protocol.dense: 12 fresh processes × (50 warm-up +25 measured), 300 pooled samples; original longer dense native runs terminated, so this is an explicit protocol deviation

protocol.limits: No browser FPS, no 60 FPS claim; fixed-detail native stress runner does not run automatic quality feedback. Host timing varies across sessions, so paired numbers and revision scope remain separate.

performance-baseline.method: Node 24 with native software Canvas, 1440x900, fixed 1/60, one readback per sample. No browser/GPU FPS claim. Sparse scenes: 50 warm-up + 300 contiguous samples. Dense scenes: 12 fresh processes, each 50 warm-up + 25 samples; 300 pooled samples. The native renderer terminates on longer dense runs, so dense measurements are explicitly batched. Identical protocol on baseline and current.
performance-baseline.revisionScope: Earlier measured implementation/baseline revision; retained for comparison, not silently relabeled as final revision
